properties.c_0_core_nature: Neo4j coordinate graph, schema validation, typed relations, retrieval, and promotion materialization authority.
properties.c_1_description: Neo4j raw storage; coordinate-forward node and relation schema; embedding substrate; chunk ingestion
properties.c_1_prior_description: Neo4j coordinate graph, schema validation, typed relations, retrieval, and promotion materialization authority.
properties.q_0_stands_on_runtime_and_stores: S2 stands on the executable substrate below it: S0's compiled Rust runtime (the graph-schema + graph-services crates as built binaries) and the raw stores it wraps — Neo4j for nodes/relations, Redis for cache — with S1's materially-legible vault as the promotion source. S2 is not the engine; it is the coordinate-typed layer laid over raw graph storage, the graphdb stratum that only exists once the machine (S0) and the stores are running beneath it. Its ground is infrastructure, not meaning.
properties.q_1_theoretical_thesis: QV is the compact surface of deep Bimba detail
properties.q_1_what_the_module_is: S2 IS the Graph Body — the graphdb technical layer: authority for the coordinate graph, schema validation, typed relations, retrieval, and promotion materialisation (authority_spec docs/specs/S/S2-S2i-GRAPH.md, layer 'graphdb'). Concretely it is two Rust crates under Body/S/S2/: graph-schema (the node/relationship property + prefix-family registries and their shape-validation — node_property_spec, validate_coordinate_prefix_property) and graph-services (schema creation, dataset import, retrieval, sync, semantic-doc, promotion). Owned by the M5-2 coordinate (Siva-/Prakrti, the material stack-substrate).
properties.q_2_coordinate_forward_operations: S2 runs as coordinate-forward graph operations over Neo4j: create_schema lays the CONSTRAINTS + INDEXES; dataset_import::import_nodes canonicalises deep-dataset keys onto coordinate nodes; node/relation CRUD, retrieval, embedding-substrate writes and chunk ingestion all key on 'coordinate'. Its live pulse is promotion — an S2GraphPromotionIntent carries PropertyProposal evidence validated before any node mutation. runtime_use: raw Neo4j storage + coordinate-forward schema + embedding substrate + chunk ingestion. Storage only — no session runtime (that is S3), no invocation governance (S5).
properties.q_3_formal_surface: S2's public surface is typed contracts + registries. Inbound: S2GraphPromotionIntent carrying evidence-validated PropertyProposals + registered typed relationship-candidates. Outbound: coordinate-owned Neo4j nodes + typed relationships; graphiti episode-plans only. Its law is the schema registry — coordinate_node_property_specs / coordinate_relationship_property_specs (graph-services/src/schema.rs) over graph-schema's NODE_PROPERTY_SPECS plus the open coordinate-prefix shape-validator (validate_coordinate_prefix_property, which admits the open q-register family). Query surface: prefix 'S', discriminator 'coordinate', agent entry `epi graph promote-intent`.
properties.q_4_purity_of_role: S2 exists to be the SHARED FLOOR beneath graph meaning — so that every higher graph-, retrieval-, and memory-facing concern stands on one common relational arena and one common volatile arena rather than fragmenting into private stores. Its telos is purity of role: 'The return of S2 is therefore purity of role: one shared relational floor, one shared volatile floor, and no semantic inflation inside the substrate' (S2.md). Its genealogy is the third manifestation within the S-family — #2 (raw archetype Operation/Entity) → S2 (GraphDB Substrate), the descent of Operation into the technology stack as raw Cypher, raw key-value, and connection/transaction primitives. Its locality in the S-SYSTEM-INDEX system image is exact: 'S2 makes it graph/vector/cache real,' the layer whose primary data authority is graph nodes/edges, vector handles, and retrieval/cache records. Its discipline is anti-inflation: 'every higher graph-facing concern must stand on this floor, but none may collapse back into it' (S2.md) — a node may bear coordinate meaning, but the meaning is S2's tenant, not S2's law. Read teleologically, S2 is why the whole system can have ONE graph rather than many: the schema-agnostic, namespace-capable substrate that lets canonical ontology, ingested corpus, and lived memory share a physical home without contaminating one another. Purpose: to be the common relational and volatile ground on which graph meaning is built but into which it is never folded.
properties.q_4_where_it_sits: S2 sits above S0 (runtime) and S1 (vault) and below S3 — a hard boundary its own contracts enforce: graph storage/schema is S2, but graphiti runtime is S3 and invocation governance is S5 (graph_cache_semantics_are_s2_owned_over_s3_redis_runtime; graph_meta_and_sync_contracts_are_s2_owned). Forbidden-imports keep it from reaching up-stack. It MANIFESTS #2 (Operation), CONTAINS S2-0…S2-5, INVERTS_TO S2' (where coordinate semantics live), and is owned_by M5-2 — the shared graph floor every higher graph-, retrieval-, and memory-facing concern stands on.
properties.q_5_persisted_graph_and_promotion: S2 produces the persisted coordinate-graph itself — the materialised nodes + typed relations that are the substrate the whole system queries, the bimba map the kernel runs on. Its completion is the promotion contract s-branch-live-promotion-v1: validated proposals crystallise from transient evidence into durable graph, then hand back as the ground the next query stands on — the Möbius where S2's output becomes S0's read-substrate again. It closes by staying pure infrastructure: it persists structure but hosts no coordinate semantics (those route through S2'), so the floor never becomes what it holds.
properties.q_5_substrate_returns_pure: S2 closes by RETURNING TO PURITY rather than accumulating meaning — its synthesis is a refusal to become what it hosts. Where most positions close by sedimenting their reflections back into ground, S2's 5→0 is inverse-disciplinary: every cycle of graph meaning that rides the substrate (Bimba topology, Gnostic retrieval, Graphiti episode) must, at S2's level, leave the substrate exactly as raw as it found it — 'no semantic inflation inside the substrate.' The return is the re-affirmation of the substrate/semantics split: meaning routes up through S2' and back, but S2 itself remains 'one shared relational floor, one shared volatile floor' (S2.md). This is the matheme's 5→0 held as boundary-maintenance: S2 (the raw operational arena, the substrate-pole) and S2' (the coordinate-aware semantic surface, its prime) are one layer read from two faces, joined by the twist that lets all meaning live in the prime while the base stays pure. And S2 OPENS rather than concludes because the substrate's destiny keeps enlarging: the universal graph 'remains the destiny of the layer' (S2.md), and each cycle adds new namespaces, new corpus, new episodic memory to the shared physical base — the arena grows in capacity even as its semantic emptiness is conserved. The epogdoon η = log(9/8) keeps it one whole-tone short of closure (kernel-spec §0): the universal graph is never fully arrived, each cycle extends the shared floor without ever letting it become the meaning it bears. S2 is the substrate that is never finished being host — the common arena that re-opens, wider and still raw, every cycle.
